raj: heads up — fenrir-int4 PTQ run is producing non-JSON suffixes when a KV-prefix is present; failure rate jumped after kernel v2.1 patch. sample below.

emily: can you paste one of the failing model outputs? :eyes:

raj: raw model output (copied verbatim):
```
{"action":{"tool":"refund","args":{"charge_id":"ch_1234"}},}

Please apply refund retroactively for order 9932.
```

emily: validator complains: trailing comma + free-text after JSON -> we reject.

toni: we shipped a token remap in kernel v2.1 to improve perf; streaming chunk concatenation may be introducing an extra "," token at chunk boundaries.

kevin: is this only when stream=true? or also with non-streaming invokes?

raj: observed in both, but stream=true amplifies it. quick curl repro I used: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST' -d '{"model":"fenrir-int4","prompt":"<tooling>","stream":false}'
```

onboard-bot: deploy event: ptq-run/fenrir-int4 -> pool-3 (kernel=v2.1) at 2025-11-02T08:14:02Z

emily: quick A/B after 2k synthetic prompts (same prompt set):
- strict-parser fail: 18.9%
- strict+repair (strip trailing commas + trim trailing plaintext) fail: 2.5%
- kv_prefix disabled, strict fail: 3.6%

toni: that delta strongly suggests kv_prefix + chunk concat interaction rather than prompt content.

kevin: mitigation ideas: 
- pin kernel to v2.0 for high-SLO routes (rollback)
- runtime: disable continuous-batching for this model id
- runtime: emit an explicit chunk separator token between streaming chunks so parsers don't see accidental merges
- short-term: opt-in 1-attempt json-repair postprocess for non-critical routes (heuristic)

raj: preference: runtime separator first; if not feasible quickly, rollback kernel for critical traffic. keep json-repair opt-in.

emily: I'll run a batch sweep [2,4,8,16] x continuous-batching on/off and collect token-level diffs around EOS boundaries. uploading results to /evals/fenrir-ptq-20251102 (ETA ~4h).

toni: I'll prototype a tiny runtime change that inserts <EOS_BOUNDARY> between chunks and run a short smoke to see if failures drop.

raj: filing ORB-3301 with initial triage notes and linking this thread. priority=P2. tagging @emily @toni @kevin for follow-up.

kevin: keep json-repair scoped and opt-in. do not GA until we understand root cause. :+1:

emily: will attach artifacts + a short postmortem to ORB-3301 when done.
